meta.name: novel-game-analyze
meta.description: Deconstruct a novel for game adaptation. Compress a raw novel, deconstruction library, or writing project into a SOURCE_BIBLE with cited textual evidence, extracting world rules, player verbs, spaces, character will, systems, and visual anchors — without inventing a genre yet. Use for gameable book analysis, analyze a novel for game adaptation, extract game systems from a book. 游戏化拆书。把原始小说、拆文库或写作工程压缩成有必要原文证据的 SOURCE_BIBLE，提取世界规则、玩家动词、空间、角色意志、系统和视觉锚点，不提前发明游戏类型。用于游戏化拆书、分析小说的游戏改编基础等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解小说，产出带原文证据的游戏改编设定集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把小说改编成游戏，需要先理清哪些内容能变成玩法规则
copy.tagline_en: Break down a novel into a game-ready source bible with cited evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to adapt a novel into a game and need to identify playable elements first

howto.what: 将小说（或拆文库）拆解为 SOURCE_BIBLE，逐单元提取世界规则、玩家动词、空间、角色意志、系统和视觉锚点，并附原文证据；不预设游戏类型。
howto.when: 当你请它做游戏化拆书、分析小说以改编游戏、或从书中提取游戏系统时触发。

say.text: 把《流浪地球》拆解成游戏设计的 SOURCE_BIBLE，附原文证据。
say.note: 会生成一份 SOURCE_BIBLE.md 并附证据。

say.text: 分析这本小说的游戏改编基础，提取世界规则和可玩动词。
say.note: 会输出世界规则、玩家动词等维度。

say.text: 用游戏化拆书流程处理前五章，先给出覆盖记录。
say.note: 会先做逐章提取并记录覆盖情况。

howto.what_en: Decomposes a novel (or existing deconstruction library) into a SOURCE_BIBLE: chapter-by-chapter extraction of world rules, player verbs, spaces, character will, systems, and visual anchors with cited text evidence, without pre-selecting a game genre.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a gameability breakdown of a book, analysis of a novel for game adaptation, or extraction of game systems from a book.

say_en.text: Break down the novel into a game-design SOURCE_BIBLE with cited evidence.
say_en.note: It will generate SOURCE_BIBLE.md with evidence.

say_en.text: Analyze this book's game adaptation basis and extract world rules and player verbs.
say_en.note: Outputs the requested dimensions and an adaptation boundary table.

say_en.text: Run the gameability pipeline on the first five chapters and give a coverage record first.
say_en.note: It tracks success/failure coverage before full synthesis.
